projects.title: Selected
projects.description: I'm interested in how products take shape — from the problem we're solving to the technology and decisions behind the solution. These projects show both collaborative university work and independent development.
projects.vehicleAlt: Vehicle Monitoring dashboard with telemetry charts

vehicle.summary: A monitoring dashboard for electronic devices installed in buses, developed with a real company and later extended independently.
vehicle.problem: Turning historical onboard-device telemetry into clearer insights for technical monitoring.
vehicle.approach: Stakeholder discussions, feature prioritization, team development and independent improvements.
vehicle.learning: Understanding what a business actually needs, rather than simply focusing on what it asks for, is essential to developing a useful solution.
vehicle.note: Case study with dashboard, device details and analytics screenshots.

stillia.summary: A mobile app that helps users develop more mindful screen-time habits through usage insights, mindfulness and guided breathing exercises (breathwork).
stillia.problem: Helping people understand their digital habits without turning progress into pressure.
stillia.approach: Mobile flows, usage statistics, design iterations and a demo experience.
stillia.learning: Balancing product goals, usability and technical constraints.
stillia.note: Case study with app screenshots, statistics and feature demonstrations.
